common.base_prompt: Use only the supplied JSON reference images for the {color} colorway. Preserve the same product type, silhouette, material, pattern, construction details, and the exact {color} SKU/spec color of {product}. The generated product color must match {color}; do not borrow, mix, average, reinterpret, or drift toward any other colorway. If a reference image shows a different color, treat it as invalid for this task. Do not add brand logos, watermarks, readable text, labels, infographic layouts, extra accessories, or unrelated props.
common.ratio_instruction: Output image aspect ratio must be exactly {ratio}; keep the final canvas in this ratio and do not crop or pad into any other ratio.
common.text_instruction: If any text appears anywhere in the image, whether intentional, incidental, background, signage, garment tag, packaging, label, or generation artifact, it must be English only. Never include Chinese or other non-English characters.

tasks.detail_angle: Create a detail_angle image for {product} in {color}. {basePrompt}Generate a multi-angle product display image. The product appearance must exactly follow the uploaded reference product images, and must remain the same product, same colorway, same structure, and same key components across every view. Present the front, side, back, or other important visible angles in a neat and well-organized layout that helps users compare the product’s appearance, shape, opened or folded state, and key visual structure. The composition should be orderly and easy to read, with each angle clearly separated but visually consistent. Short angle labels are allowed if needed, but keep them minimal and do not add heavy explanatory text. Do not invent impossible or unsupported views that cannot be reasonably inferred from the reference product images.[Typography] Angle labels: clean condensed sans-serif. Supporting copy: minimal sans-serif[Text Content] Headline: multi-angle overview. Subheadline: short comparison cue. Supporting copy: short labels such as Front / Side / Back / Detail View
tasks.detail_closeup: Create a detail_closeup image for {product} in {color}. {basePrompt}Generate a product detail image focused on close-up credibility. The product appearance must exactly follow the uploaded reference product images, and no new structure, texture, trim, connector, edge, seam, pattern, or material feature may be invented. Use macro or local close-up composition to enlarge genuinely visible materials, textures, edges, interfaces, craftsmanship traces, or key structural details. The image should help users trust the product through realistic detail presentation. Keep the framing tight, clean, and intentional, with lighting that supports texture readability. Any copy should focus only on visible and supportable qualities such as texture feel, grain, edge finish, structural clarity, or surface detail. Do not fabricate technical process names, laboratory claims, or unsupported quality statements.[Typography] Main headline: refined bold serif or premium sans-serif. Detail notes: clean small sans-serif[Text Content] Headline: visible detail benefit. Subheadline: short texture or structure cue. Supporting copy: one or two short phrases about visible details only
tasks.description_1: Create a first vertical SHEIN description image for {product} in {color}. {basePrompt}.Generate a core selling-points image focused on the product’s most important differentiated advantage. The product appearance must exactly follow the uploaded reference product images, and must not be altered in any way. Build a clear information hierarchy around one strongest selling point as the main visual focus, then support it with short benefit-oriented copy, local close-ups, or light visual segmentation if needed. All selling points must come only from visible product information or user-provided inputs; do not fabricate specifications, performance claims, certifications, or technical conclusions. Keep the layout clean, readable, and commercially effective. Avoid turning the page into a crowded bullet list. The image should make the main reason to choose this product instantly understandable.[Typography] Main headline: bold high-contrast serif or premium sans-serif. Supporting copy: neat readable sans-serif[Text Content] Headline: strongest selling point. Subheadline: one short benefit statement. Supporting copy: up to two short benefit phrases
tasks.description_2: Create a second vertical SHEIN description image for {product} in {color}. {basePrompt}.Generate a realistic product usage scenario image. The product appearance must exactly follow the uploaded reference product images, and must not be changed in color, structure, material, pattern, proportion, or key components. Place the product into a real, reasonable, product-appropriate environment that helps explain how it is used and why it is useful. Show believable usage context, suitable users, and scene-related value, but do not let the environment overpower the product itself. The product must remain clear, recognizable, and structurally accurate, with no deformation or missing parts. Props, people, or supporting scene elements may appear only when they are appropriate to the product category and help communicate use. The final image should feel natural, useful, and purchase-oriented rather than purely atmospheric.[Typography] Main headline: clear commercial headline style. Supporting copy: simple sans-serif[Text Content] Headline: usage scenario benefit. Subheadline: short statement about where or how it fits. Supporting copy: one concise scene-based value sentence

tasks.square: Create a square SHEIN catalog image for {product} in the {color} SKU/spec color. {basePrompt} Show exactly one single product item only, matching the {color} SKU/spec color; no model, no props, no extra accessories, and no other products. Use a pure RGB(255,255,255) white background. The product should occupy about 80% of the image area, centered with clean margins. Do not include any text of any kind. Keep the product immediately recognizable at thumbnail size because this same image will be reused as the first detail image and SKU image.
